notes.title: Now available: 'Hamburg: Neue Burg VR'
notes.content:
It's finally here: The game is now available for download! A long and insightful journey comes to an end and I am really excited to hear what you think about this VR time travel app through the history of Hamburg.

Allthough I have developed VR and non-VR apps in the past for specific projects, this is the first one published for a wider audience on Steam.

For questions, problems and any kind of feedback please use the discussion board. 

Have fun!
